title: Some cute stuff for the dogs
text: I got three boxes before canceling my subscription. It isn’t awful, but not worth what you’re paying in my opinion. During my subscription I got an icky smelling facial cleanser, and a silver peeling face mask that was not fun to remove. The dog products aren’t bad as far as toys but I have three dogs so the box only coming with one of certain treats was another deciding factor for me.
label: neutral
